title.narrative: Social Transformation Research and Policy Advocacy

description.narrative: Over an 72-month period, the action will work towards the following general objective: more inclusive and sustainable economic growth policy and programming approaches are undertaken in northern Ghana by 2025. The implementation objective is that: local, regional and national decision-makers, better understand which social transformation conditions promote sustainable and inclusive rural development and the implementation of climate change adaptation and mitigation practices, and they are able to apply and implement social transformation analysis in their development planning.
